messages:
Sasha: Quick UX spike — proposing a compact, foldable legend for stacked/overlaid series. Each series gets a small toggle, a tiny unit badge (e.g. GB, %), and an optional per-series smoothing switch. Sketch: https://img.redwood/proposals/leg-fold-01.png

Michael: Nice — saves vertical real estate. Two concerns: 1) discoverability on mobile (collapsed legend might hide important series), 2) keyboard focus order when items are folded.

Lee: Accessibility nit: screen readers need deterministic labels for the folded state. Example SR announcement when user opens the legend:
```
"Legend, 4 series. Focus: CPU percent (toggled on). Memory in GB (toggled on). Disk I/O (toggled off). Network (toggled on). Use arrow keys to navigate, space to toggle."
```
This prevents "option 3 of 4" ambiguity. Also add aria-pressed on toggles and aria-expanded on the fold button.

Ana: On smoothing: I prefer per-series smoothing controls. Global smoothing hides how individual metrics interact. Small inline toggle keeps context close to label. Also recommend a microcopy tooltip: "Smoothing reduces short-term spikes for clearer trends; toggling may hide anomalies."

Priya: Outlier handling: we should avoid silent clipping. Proposal: default = annotate outliers with a faint marker + tooltip; optional clamp mode behind an advanced setting. For axis labels, show scaled units but keep unit badge on each series. Example axis label formats:
```
1000 -> 1k
1500000 -> 1.5M
Display: 1.5M (requests)
```
And hover state shows exact value + unit.

Michael: +1 to annotate, and add a small info icon with "why this looks clipped" copy. Also: if fold hides a series, indicate that in the chart legend visually (dimmed glyph + "hidden").

Sasha: UX follow-ups I can action: update mock to include keyboard focus states, add SR sample strings, and swap global smoothing for per-series option. Will post new mock by EOD. @design-bot can you add this to Wed review? :thumbsup:

Design-bot: Scheduled: Design review — Wed 10:00 AM (Zoom link in calendar). Added PR #1234 with updated mock and notes.

Priya: tiny copy tweak suggestion for the fold control: change "Show"/"Hide" to "Expand legend"/"Collapse legend" for clarity with screen readers.

Lee: Agree on copy. Also request QA checklist item: keyboard tab order, ARIA attributes, NVDA/VoiceOver pass.

Sasha: Great — I'll include checklist in the PR. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
